global: pizzicato strings, chiptune square-wave lead, tuba, glockenspiel, light funky drums, woodblock

sections.name: hook
sections.style: comic chaos: a springy boing launch, rising slide-whistle, a big cymbal crash, frantic chiptune arpeggio

sections.name: launch
sections.style: triumphant celebration: bright brass fanfare mixed with an 8-bit victory melody, confident marching drums, sparkling glockenspiel

sections.name: played
sections.style: everything stops: a short comic suspense pause, single plucked note, tiptoe pizzicato

sections.name: glitch
sections.style: wobbly glitchy slapstick: bouncy tuba, stuttering chiptune notes that skip and repeat, warbly pitch bends, comic boings and spooky theremin-like wobble

sections.name: score
sections.style: deadpan beat then a proud mock-heroic fanfare swell with timpani and an 8-bit victory jingle

sections.name: ending
sections.style: warm bouncy playful outro, glockenspiel and pizzicato with a chiptune twinkle, cheeky button ending
